verdicts.reason: A reads cleanly from left to right: headline, then copy, then product, then CTA, with clear hierarchy and even spacing. Its flaws are the legal line, which is about 7px and too small to read, and a product/circle that is small and loses the sun detail. In B the body copy is set nearly as large as '20% off', so the two compete. B's three-line copy block is also jammed against the headline, 'WEEKEND ONLY' sits tight to the top edge, and it has the same unreadable legal text.
